source.title: AI delivers 'zero financial payoff' to most companies, Apollo economist says
source.author: throwoutway

title.zh: 企业AI投资为何尚未兑现财务回报
title.en: Corporate AI Has Yet to Deliver Broad Financial Returns

excerpt.zh: Apollo经济学家称，科技巨头以外的标普493家公司尚未显现AI带来的利润率或人均收入提升；企业能否把AI能力转化为可衡量的业务价值仍待观察。
excerpt.en: Apollo economist Torsten Slok says AI has yet to lift margins or revenue per worker across the S&P 493 outside major tech firms, leaving its broader business payoff unproven.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: 企业AI能否带来可见的财务回报，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。Apollo Global Management首席经济学家托斯滕·斯洛克指出，在科技行业之外，尚未看到大型企业的利润表现因AI而改善。
text.en: Whether enterprise AI can produce measurable financial returns remains an open question. Torsten Slok, chief economist at Apollo Global Management, says there is not yet evidence that AI has improved the financial performance of large companies outside the technology sector.

text.zh: 标普493的指标尚未显现提升
text.en: S&P 493 Metrics Show No Clear Lift

text.zh: 斯洛克将标普500中剔除Alphabet、亚马逊、苹果、Meta、微软、英伟达和特斯拉后的公司称为“标普493”。根据他对利润率和人均收入的观察，这些企业的相关指标基本持平，尚无证据显示AI提高了生产率。
text.en: Slok uses “S&P 493” to refer to the S&P 500 excluding Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft, Nvidia and Tesla. In his assessment, profit margins and revenue per worker for this group appear broadly flat, with no evidence so far that AI has raised productivity.

text.zh: 企业AI回报取决于业务判断
text.en: Enterprise AI Returns Depend on Business Judgment

text.zh: 这一判断并不等于证明AI在所有企业都毫无价值，而是说明投入和热度尚未转化为广泛可见的财务成效。斯洛克认为，降低获取智能的成本并不必然带来更快的营收增长或更高的利润率；企业决策还涉及责任、信任、文化、伦理取舍与公平等因素。
text.en: This assessment does not prove that AI has no value in every company; it says that investment and enthusiasm have not yet translated into broadly visible financial gains. Slok argues that cheaper access to intelligence does not automatically create faster revenue growth or higher margins. Business decisions also involve accountability, trust, culture, ethical trade-offs and fairness.

text.zh: 报道还提到，近期研究同样未发现显著的生产率提升。不过，现有材料没有给出斯洛克分析的具体时间范围、方法细节或逐行业数据，因此不能据此断言AI未来无法创造回报。关键问题仍是企业能否把工具嵌入实际工作流程，并让效率改善最终反映在可靠的经营指标上。
text.en: The report also notes that recent studies have yet to find significant productivity gains. The supplied account does not provide the analysis’s precise time period, methodological details or industry-by-industry data, so it cannot establish that AI will never generate returns. The key question is whether companies can integrate these tools into real workflows and turn efficiency improvements into measurable business results.
